title: Promotion
description: How a set of reviewed drafts becomes a deployable course. Lives beside the drafts under sandbox/drafts/ and is read by tools/promote.py. Nothing here reaches the database — it describes the packaging step, and the lesson.yaml it generates is what deploys.

target.description: Repo-relative path of the course this fills. The course must already exist — promotion writes lessons/, never course.yaml, so a course's identity and its enabled flag stay under human control.

source.description: Repo-relative directory holding the draft decks named below.

assetRoots.description: Where a flattened basename is looked up, in order. shared/assets is always appended last, so a draft-local image wins over a shared one of the same name.

source.description: Deck path relative to spec.source. A subdirectory is allowed because that is the shape the track drafts actually have — one directory per lesson, holding lesson.html beside its lesson.yaml — while the trial decks sit flat in one folder. Traversal is refused: `promote.py` joins this onto spec.source without further checking, so the pattern is what keeps a manifest inside the drafts tree.

slug.description: Lesson directory name. Permanent by convention — it is what a human uses to find the lesson.

week.description: CLASS_WEEK. Contiguous from 1 across the manifest; a gap makes a lesson unreachable.
